provenance: All schedules and boundaries below are Task 2 analytical choices. ISAAC supports the resident-MVM concept and partitioned input/reduction, not a Qwen hardware implementation or BF16 support claim.

notation.r: positive logical output rows per tile
notation.c: positive logical input columns per tile
notation.U: vectors served, partitioned across epochs and copies; model weights shared across batch
notation.D: maintained replicas of each K/V layout

boundary_rules.logical_operator: One declared full matrix service, with internal output sharing, complete dot products and output availability. Requires full logical resident capacity; may require a macro group.
boundary_rules.tile_port: Count receiving tile ports separately. For every placement epoch, traverse output blocks then input blocks; each tile serves that epoch's vectors before eviction. Split input columns into segments, replicate across output blocks. All static tiles and all growing KV tiles must remain resident.
boundary_rules.padding: Only valid logical elements cross input/write boundaries; invalid slots internally zeroed or disabled. Slot occupancy is capacity/utilization metadata, not useful payload. Zero gating and partial writes are pairing conditions.
boundary_rules.output: Reduction across input-column tiles is required. Partial-sum accumulation and output completion must be represented by compatible service capability. Their outputs are not added to Q_S unless used as a later CIM input.
boundary_rules.precision: All payload accounting is logical; bit slicing, ADC passes and write verify do not multiply these bytes. Named BF16 and INT16 modes are distinct.
boundary_rules.replicas: U/query heads partitioned across resident replicas; every maintained copy is written, no duplicate useful computation. Capacity scales with copies. Serial sharing is allowed; no common performance rate asserted.

G0_LO.schedule: matrix pre-resident; unchanged during U-vector window

G0_TP.schedule: all matrix tiles pre-resident; each receiving tile serves its segments

G1_LO.schedule: load full matrix once, serve U vectors

G1_TP.schedule: for each tile: load valid weights once, serve all U corresponding segments, emit partial results; one scratch tile can suffice with external input/partial-sum storage

G2_LO.schedule: shared operator region evicts weights between chunks; load same full matrix once per epoch

G2_TP.schedule: each epoch traverses all tiles anew; inputs served once per output block per epoch's vector subset

A1_LO.schedule: per new token j: append K row and V-transposed column; each query head uses its group's current prefix in QK then AV; retain all KV

A1_TP.schedule: fixed tile coordinates as prefix grows; append only new valid elements, preserving old values; for each query traverse its visible K tiles, finish scores/softmax, traverse V-transposed tiles; retain all KV tiles
A1_TP.writes: same valid KV append payload as A1_LO; partial row/column updates required

T1_LO.schedule: W and W-transposed initially resident; each microbatch: forward(X,W), dX(dY,W-transposed), dW(dY-transposed,X-transposed); external dW accumulation; end: update W and W-transposed once each
T1_LO.alternative: dW-transposed via resident dY-transposed and streaming X-transposed; separate sensitivity component

T1_TP.schedule: retain all W and W-transposed tiles; tile temporary X-transposed in scratch per microbatch; accumulate complete dW externally; write each valid weight element once in each maintained layout at cycle end
T1_TP.writes: same logical elements as T1_LO; tile output splits change component streaming inputs

F1_LO.schedule: concatenate independent Q/K/V or gate/up resident output rows and receive one shared X per vector; a different service boundary from independent projections
F1_LO.Q_S: one U*n_in*b_S service, not the sum of separate input receptions

capacity_conditions: Dynamic tile GEMM can use one scratch tile plus declared external activation and partial-sum workspace.
Static logical GEMM and G0_TP require the full matrix or all tiles already present.
A1 requires all final per-session K/V tiles retained; decode initial history is already resident, prefill initial history is empty.
T1 retains both full weight layouts. Temporary activation capacity can be tiled; gradient accumulator and optimizer workspace are external to this operand scope.
Logical slot counts are not physical bitcell counts.
